column3: Panamanian lawmakers’ Taiwan trip sparks diplomatic row with China
column4: If you thought the Canal was the only thing that could split continents, this row proves paperwork can do it too—no ships required, just a lot of angry diplomats.
column5: In an alternate reality the Panama Canal turned into a giant water slide; the lawmakers slid straight into a Taiwanese tea ceremony, prompting China to unleash an inflatable dragon to block the exit.
